name: spreadarray_for_non_concat_spreadables_d8e830d1
subject: Fix __spreadArray for non-concat-spreadables (#45386)
not_strict_reasons: no failing case added by the fix

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: The __spreadArray helper called to.concat(from) on non-concat-spreadable inputs, which could spread incorrectly. The fix copies the array-like input with Array.prototype.slice before concatenating.
